title: Minecraft v2
features:
Features : creative mode, accurate minecraft movement, accurate physics, steve model, block placement and block removal (includes world too), you can hit players or even kill any entity / npc. 
Info : this is purely recreation of minecraft java edition not ported. It's still on work in progress so expect bugs, catalog blocks and items of creative mode is coming soon. Any icon or something that looks off, it's because i didn't have texture for it. I still had to find or make textures and many other mechanics. Possibly discontinued, it's client side but actual player movement still replicates to others players (the animation doesn't replicate). I recommend for mobile users to use another keyboard if pasting doesn't work, because it's too long. Or just straight up execute it in game if you have delta or any executor that involves scriptblox as their search user generated scripts engine.
